newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta exchange turnover down at $1.6mln, trade flat.
newsitem.headline: Malta exchange turnover down at $1.6mln, trade flat.

text.p: Market turnover in the once-weekly trading session of the Malta Stock Exchange maintained similar levels to last week on Wednesday, although business in bank shares was quieter.
Turnover reached 623,000 Maltese pounds ($1.6 million) from the previous week's 672,000 pounds. There were 93 deals of which 36 were in equities and 57 in fixed income securities.
The share index dropped one point to 981.87.
Business in equities topped 30,900 pounds, with 24,382 shares transacted. Of these, 7,100 were in Bank of Valletta transacted in 19 deals for an average 123 cents per share, unchanged.
There was one deal in Mid-Med Bank with 1,300 shares transacted for 149 cents per share, also unchanged.

In Lombard Bank Malta 12,427 shares changed hands for an average 139.9 cents per shares, down a mil. Two deals were struck in Middle Sea Insurance where 1,500 shares were transacted for an average 122.7 cents, unchanged, while 2,055 ordinary Simonds Farsons Cisk shares were sold for an average 50 cents, also unchanged.

In government bonds, 10 issues were dealt in, turnover reaching just over 580,000 pounds. Business was mainly in the 7.25 percent MGS 2006 (III), 6.5 percent MGS 2001 (II) and the 7.5 percent MGS 2011.

There were nine deals in Mid-Med Bank 7.25 percent unsecured loan stock 2005 amounting to 10,106 pounds, while in the 6.5 percent Gasan Bonds 1998/99 one deal was transacted amounting to Lm1,972. $1: 0.38 pounds
